# Oliver Heath Design

> > A biophilic and sustainable interior design studio creating spaces that prioritize human wellbeing, occupant health, and environmental responsibility.

Oliver Heath Design is a London-based design practice specializing in human-centered, evidence-based interior design that integrates nature-inspired principles with sustainable practices. The studio works across residential, commercial, and hospitality sectors, with notable projects including wellness spaces, workplace transformations, and residential developments.

## Key Topics

- Biophilic Design
- Wellbeing-Centered Design
- Sustainable Interior Design
- Workplace Design & Office Transformation
- Design Strategy & Consulting

- Occupant Health
- WELL Standard Certification

- Residential & Commercial Projects
- Oliver Heath
- London Design Studio

- Interior Sustainability

## Core Services & Philosophy

- [Oliver Heath Design | Spaces That Support Wellbeing and Sustainability](https://www.oliverheathdesign.com): Homepage introducing Oliver Heath Design's biophilic and sustainable interior design services.
- [What We Do | Design That Puts People and Planet First](https://www.oliverheathdesign.com/our-services): Overview of Oliver Heath Design's services spanning design strategy, spatial design, and wellbeing-focused solutions.
- [Approach](https://www.oliverheathdesign.com/approach): Oliver Heath Design's human-centered, evidence-based design philosophy emphasizing biophilic and sustainable principles.
- [Meet Oliver Heath Design | Why We Care About Better Spaces](https://www.oliverheathdesign.com/about-us): Company overview introducing Oliver Heath Design's team and mission for healthier, sustainable spaces.

## Project Portfolio & Case Studies

- [Our Work | Real Spaces That Make a Difference](https://www.oliverheathdesign.com/our-projects): Portfolio showcasing Oliver Heath Design's residential, commercial, and hospitality projects using biophilic design.
- [RE:MIND](https://www.oliverheathdesign.com/our-projects/remind): Case study of RE:MIND wellness space at Victoria station, London, with WELL standard certification.
- [Taisei Workplace | Borderless Design Inspired by Nature](https://www.oliverheathdesign.com/our-projects/taisei-workplace-japan): Case study of Taisei workplace in Japan featuring borderless design and nature-inspired office concepts.
- [John Lewis Partnership](https://www.oliverheathdesign.com/our-projects/john-lewis-partnership-build-to-rent): Case study of John Lewis Partnership residential development using biophilic design and sustainability.
- [Westfield](https://www.oliverheathdesign.com/our-projects/westfield-pop-up): Case study of Westfield pop-up retail space featuring biophilic design and multisensory wellbeing experience.
